body.name: Rmax
body.type: dense deterministic response-table enumeration bound per saturated order
body.def: \(R_{\max}=\max_{\prec}\prod_{j\in W}r_j^{(\prod_{i\prec j}r_i)K_{\max}^{2^{N-1}}}\), where \(\prec\) ranges over topological orders on \(W\); each \(j\) has every earlier vertex as a potential endogenous input and the \(2^{N-1}\) potential child-set sources whose child sets contain \(j\)
